title: Make living-report artifact publication incremental and observable
description:
As an operator, I want large living-report milestones to publish incrementally with truthful progress and resumable work, so that account-wide portfolio reports do not remain silent or restart thousands of completed uploads after a transient interruption.

Observed behavior: a large portfolio milestone publishes every score and scorecard artifact sequentially, reports only category-level completion, and uses new object keys on retry. The visible counter can remain unchanged for minutes and a late failure repeats already completed uploads.

Feature: Incremental living-report artifact publication

Scenario: Per-artifact progress is visible
Given a milestone contains many stakeholder-safe score and scorecard artifacts
When publication is in progress
Then durable live progress advances at a bounded cadence as artifacts complete
And the Report identifies the active category and completed count

Scenario: Retry reuses verified artifacts
Given an interrupted publication has already uploaded checksum-valid immutable artifacts
When the same milestone and evidence fingerprint are retried
Then checksum-identical artifacts are reused
And only missing or changed artifacts are uploaded
And the latest Report revision changes only after complete reconciliation

Scenario: Unchanged score artifacts are not regenerated
Given a later milestone does not change a score or scorecard presentation
When that milestone is published
Then the prior immutable artifact is referenced by the new manifest
And no duplicate upload is created

Scenario: Partial publication never becomes authoritative
Given one required artifact remains missing or invalid
When publication reconciliation ends
Then the Report remains on its last complete revision
And the incomplete milestone is visibly retryable

Out of scope: GraphQL schema or resource changes; deleting historical artifacts; weakening checksum validation or atomic revision commits.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Outside-in progress increment: a 30-score publication regression first showed only 0 then 30 completed score briefs. The callback now records successful uploads and publishes compact progress every 25 artifacts plus category completion, while enforcing exact category totals before the atomic manifest commit. Focused publication tests pass, and the complete run-report suite passes: 83 tests. Retry reuse and unchanged-artifact reuse remain open.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the next publication-efficiency increment. A new milestone now loads the last committed manifest, verifies checksum-identical score, scorecard, and stakeholder-presentation artifacts, and reuses them instead of uploading duplicates. Changed dependencies republish, and corrupt reuse candidates are replaced. The full living-Report suite passes with 88 tests. Interrupted same-revision orphan recovery remains the next increment.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added durable same-revision recovery. Publication freezes its generated time, checkpoints partial score-artifact descriptors every 25 resolutions through the existing Task-attachment route, and reuses checksum-verified artifacts after a worker/process restart. It preserves the existing invariant that individual score artifacts are not added directly to Task.attachedFiles. A manifest-interruption replay now uploads evidence, workbook, and four child artifacts only once. Combined validation: 132 tests passed.
